upstreams.description: List of upstream server groups for load balancing. Each group defines one or more backend servers and optional balancing policy.

name.description: Unique name of the upstream group (used in proxy_pass).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the upstream's purpose.

balance.description: Load balancing method for the upstream group.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend server.

port.description: Port number of the backend server.

backup.description: If true, this server is only used when all non-backup servers are down.

stream_servers.description: List of stream (TCP/UDP) server blocks that define listening ports, routing rules, and proxy targets.

listen_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0', '127.0.0.1').

listen_port.description: TCP/UDP port to listen on (e.g., 5432 for PostgreSQL proxy).

protocol.description: Protocol for this server (TCP or UDP).

upstream_name.description: Name of the upstream group to proxy traffic to (must match an upstream.name).

log_name.description: Custom suffix for the access log filename (defaults to port number).

geoip_redirect.description: If true, redirect traffic not from allowed countries to a fallback host.

geoip_countries.description: List of allowed 2-letter ISO country codes (e.g., ['US', 'CA', 'GB']).

geoip_fallback_host.description: Host (with optional port) to redirect blocked traffic to (e.g., 'block.example.com:443').

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes (e.g., 'auto', '4'). Set to 'auto' for automatic CPU detection.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open files per worker (must match system ulimit -n).
